role: Building/Fire Code Official (Plan Review and Permitting)

evidence.quote: I asked for a written clarification on that point specifically rather than taking the package at face value or sending the whole thing out for a full outside review, which would have added about three weeks.
evidence.explanation: The participant devises a non-routine intermediate course of action (targeted clarification) between two obvious alternatives, weighing time cost against risk coverage—an adapted, context-sensitive resolution rather than a scripted choice.

evidence.quote: I built in defined interim checkpoints and documentation standards so the qualitative thresholds would still be auditable if anyone questioned the sign-off later.
evidence.explanation: The participant designs a supplementary control mechanism not offered by either original option, combining elements of both protocols to resolve an enforceability gap—an original, planned solution.

evidence.quote: So I granted occupancy only for the floors that didn't depend on the untested atrium system, and held back the rest until testing was done.

task_anchors.task_description: Reviewing a performance-based CFD smoke-control submittal, identifying an inadequately addressed assumption, and requesting targeted written clarification before approval.
Choosing between two commissioning/verification protocols and designing supplementary checkpoints to address enforceability of a qualitatively defined protocol.
Evaluating whether clustered fire-door deficiencies indicate a localized problem, using sample-size and randomization reasoning, and deciding to maintain the existing inspection plan.
Weighing developer schedule pressure, contractor history, and system-specific historical rework data to grant partial, conditional temporary occupancy.
